scope.statement: The crosswalk covers priority sample, observation, method, spatial and provenance semantics. D1 V4 raw, scope, citation, geology and rights fields are explicitly classified as local extensions or deferred crosswalks until additional professional schemas are reviewed. This supports import/export design and gap analysis, but does not certify conformance to EarthChem, USGS AGDB2, ODM2, IGSN or DataCite.

mapping_type_definitions.exact: The reviewed external field and canonical field have the same asserted meaning and require no semantic transformation.
mapping_type_definitions.renamed: The meaning is aligned, but a field rename or lossless identifier normalization is required.
mapping_type_definitions.transformed: A declared unit, vocabulary, date, qualifier or identifier transformation is required.
mapping_type_definitions.composite: Several external fields, a relationship join or source metadata are needed to construct the canonical value.
mapping_type_definitions.local_extension: The canonical field is intentionally maintained by this workflow for audit, QC or analysis and is not claimed as a platform field.
mapping_type_definitions.no_direct_equivalent: No direct field was identified in the cited reviewed surface. The platform may still support the concept through extensions; absence here is not proof of impossibility.

platforms.name: EarthChem Library / EarthChem data model
platforms.scope_note: Repository templates and EarthChem schema concepts for samples, measured parameters, analytical metadata and data-source metadata.

platforms.name: USGS Alaska Geochemical Database 2.0
platforms.scope_note: A concrete government geochemical dataset schema. It is evidence for field practice, not a universal USGS interchange standard.

platforms.name: Observations Data Model 2
platforms.scope_note: Relational observation model linking sampling features, actions, methods, variables, units, results, provenance and data quality.

platforms.name: IGSN metadata encoded with DataCite Metadata Schema
platforms.scope_note: Discovery and persistent-identifier metadata for physical samples; it is not an analytical-result schema.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Source-facing identifier for the sampled object or specimen.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Trim surrounding whitespace; preserve case and punctuation.
platform_mappings.information_loss: None when one EarthChem sample name identifies one canonical sample.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Prefer FIELD_ID as the collector-facing sample ID; retain LAB_ID separately in source provenance when both exist.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Choosing one identifier as sample_id loses the distinction between field and laboratory identities unless the second identifier is retained.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the code for the specimen or sampled feature represented by the result.
platform_mappings.information_loss: ODM2 sampling-feature hierarchy is not represented by this single field.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use the local sample identifier and record its alternateIdentifierType in source metadata.
platform_mappings.controlled_vocabulary: DataCite alternateIdentifierType recommendation; local is the default for project identifiers.
platform_mappings.information_loss: alternateIdentifierType is not retained in sample_id alone.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Globally persistent IGSN identifier for a physical sample or feature of interest.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the registered identifier; do not mint or infer one.
platform_mappings.information_loss: None for the identifier string.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Leave null unless a separate authoritative sample registry supplies an IGSN.
platform_mappings.information_loss: AGDB2 sample IDs must not be relabeled as IGSNs.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Select the sampling-feature external identifier whose system is IGSN.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Resolver URI and identifier-system metadata are not retained in igsn alone.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Accept the DOI-form IGSN identifier only when identifierType is DOI and the record is registered as an IGSN ID.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Registration state and repository metadata require the full DataCite record.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Canonical target element or analyte used for grouping and comparison.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Map the reported parameter through the audited analyte vocabulary; preserve the original label in analyte_reported.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Speciation or oxide form can be lost unless species_or_oxide is also populated.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve the AGDB2 species code and normalize only recognized element/analyte synonyms.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The source species code must also be retained in analyte_reported or species_or_oxide.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use VariableNameCV semantics and retain VariableCode as the source-reported label.
platform_mappings.information_loss: ODM2 variable type and speciation require other canonical fields.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Do not derive analytical variables from sample discovery metadata.
platform_mappings.information_loss: IGSN/DataCite describes the sample, not individual analytical determinations.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Verbatim or minimally normalized source label for the measured parameter.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the submitted parameter label before canonical analyte normalization.
platform_mappings.information_loss: None if the source label is preserved exactly.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the source species code or label.
platform_mappings.information_loss: A code needs the AGDB2 lookup table for its full definition.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy VariableCode; use VariableNameCV and SpeciationCV for interpretation.
platform_mappings.information_loss: VariableCode alone is not a complete ODM2 variable definition.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Reported chemical species, oxide or compound form when distinct from the target element.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Parse only an explicit species or oxide label from the submitted parameter; do not infer from units.
platform_mappings.information_loss: None when the parameter explicitly encodes species; otherwise remain null.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy a species/oxide code and resolve its source definition before conversion.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The short code is ambiguous without Chem2 metadata.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the controlled speciation term associated with the variable.
platform_mappings.information_loss: None when one controlled term fully describes the reported species.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: High-level canonical sample medium: rock, soil, sediment, water, mineral, concentrate or unknown.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Map the physical sample medium separately from the analyzed fraction; unmatched terms become unknown and remain in material.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The seven-value canonical vocabulary is coarser than repository-specific sample classifications.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Map documented primary classes rock, sediment, soil, mineral and concentrate; preserve subclasses in material.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Secondary and specific sample classification is lost unless material is populated.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Map the ODM2 medium term to the canonical seven-value vocabulary and preserve the original term in material when narrower.
platform_mappings.information_loss: ODM2 terms may be more specific than the canonical medium.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use explicit material terms only; resourceTypeGeneral=PhysicalObject alone is insufficient.
platform_mappings.controlled_vocabulary: DataCite resourceTypeGeneral and optional subject scheme
platform_mappings.information_loss: Free-text title/subject parsing may be ambiguous and must fail to unknown.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Source-specific material, fraction or sample-class description retained alongside medium.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Prefer analyzed material for the measured fraction and retain lithology separately.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Multiple fractions cannot be represented in one scalar field without a declared join rule.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Concatenate non-empty subclass and specific name with labeled components.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Hierarchy is flattened unless source fields are retained in provenance.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Combine specimen type and medium only when both apply to the measured sampling feature.
platform_mappings.controlled_vocabulary: ODM2 SpecimenType and Medium controlled vocabularies
platform_mappings.information_loss: Sampling-feature hierarchy and subsample relationships are flattened.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy an explicit material term; retain the subject scheme when provided in source provenance.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Subject scheme and multilingual titles are not represented in material alone.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Basis on which concentration is reported, such as dry total, wet, dissolved or extractable.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Construct only from explicit analyzed-material and method statements; do not infer dry/total from concentration units.
platform_mappings.information_loss: A scalar basis cannot preserve the full analytical procedure.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use the method definition and species to classify basis; method code alone is insufficient.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Method details remain necessary to interpret partial versus total extraction.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Derive from the specimen, action/method and processing level only when the workflow explicitly states the measurement basis.
platform_mappings.controlled_vocabulary: ODM2 method, action and specimen controlled vocabularies
platform_mappings.information_loss: The relational workflow is reduced to one label.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Do not infer analytical basis from sample PID metadata.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Analytical basis requires observation/method metadata outside the IGSN discovery record.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Numeric component of the source-reported analytical result before unit normalization.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Parse the numeric component while retaining qualifiers and raw text in their canonical audit fields.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Formatting and qualifier syntax are lost unless original_value_raw and value_qualifier are retained.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the numeric result after source-specific encoded-value rules are resolved.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Encoded detection-limit semantics require QUALIFIER and source metadata.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the measurement value linked to the relevant ResultID.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Value date/time and result relationships are not carried by this scalar field.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Do not place analytical result values in sample PID metadata fields.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Analytical values require a separate observation dataset.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Unit string associated with the source-reported analytical value.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Preserve the submitted unit before canonical unit parsing.
platform_mappings.information_loss: None when the source unit string is retained.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the documented concentration or measurement unit.
platform_mappings.information_loss: None for the unit label; measurement basis remains separate.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve Results.UnitsID and copy UnitsAbbreviation.
platform_mappings.information_loss: UnitsName, type and URI are not represented by the abbreviation alone.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Canonical qualifier describing reported, approximate, inequality, non-detect, trace or unknown result semantics.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Parse only explicit qualifier syntax in the submitted value; otherwise use reported.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The reviewed template overview does not establish a dedicated qualifier field.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Map the documented source qualifier to the canonical vocabulary; never interpret undocumented negative or tail-digit codes globally.
platform_mappings.controlled_vocabulary: AGDB2 QUALIFIER domain plus dataset metadata
platform_mappings.information_loss: Source-specific qualifier distinctions may collapse to the smaller canonical vocabulary.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Map censor-code terms to lt/le/gt/ge/nd where semantics are exact; keep other terms unknown.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Approximate and trace semantics may require quality metadata or annotations beyond CensorCodeCV.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Boolean indicating that the exact analytical value is bounded or not quantitatively reported.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Set true only after the documented qualifier/encoding proves censoring.
platform_mappings.controlled_vocabulary: AGDB2 QUALIFIER domain and dataset-specific encoding rules
platform_mappings.information_loss: The boolean loses censor direction and limit, which must remain in value_qualifier and limit fields.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Set true for controlled censor terms and false for not censored.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The boolean does not retain the specific censor term.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Do not derive censoring from sample PID metadata.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Censoring belongs to analytical results, outside IGSN metadata scope.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Reason a value is absent, kept distinct from zero and censoring.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Assign only when source metadata explicitly distinguishes missing, not analyzed or insufficient sample; otherwise unknown.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Historic source codes may not distinguish every canonical missing reason.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use NoDataValue to detect absence and annotations only when they explicitly state the reason.
platform_mappings.information_loss: ODM2 core NoDataValue does not itself encode the canonical reason categories.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Leave null unless the submitted source explicitly states a missing reason.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Blank cells cannot safely distinguish not reported from not analyzed.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Comparable concentration after an audited unit or stoichiometric conversion.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Import source value and unit, then apply only D2 scientific-rules conversions; on export, declare that the value is derived.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Exporting only normalized_value loses the reported value and conversion evidence.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Normalize from the documented value, unit and species; do not overwrite the source measurement.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The canonical target unit and analyte may be coarser than the source semantics.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Represent the normalized value as a derived Result related to the source Result and preserve the derivation equation.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Flattening ODM2 source and derived Results into one row loses the relationship graph unless conversion_formula is retained.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Target unit for comparable concentration: mg/kg for supported solids or ug/L for water.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve the repository unit and convert only under D2 medium/basis rules.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Original unit and precision require original_unit and conversion evidence.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Map documented mass-ratio or aqueous concentration units to the applicable canonical unit.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Unsupported or ambiguous units must remain unnormalized rather than be coerced.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve the source unit, convert, and associate the derived result with the canonical unit.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Unit URI and type are not retained by the abbreviation alone.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Detection or censoring bound expressed in normalized_unit without imputing a concentration.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Convert an explicitly reported limit with the same audited rule used for the value; never use it as normalized_value.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Limit type and method context require the source method metadata.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Treat DATA_VALUE as a limit only when QUALIFIER and dataset metadata explicitly establish that meaning, then convert units.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Historic encodings may conflate reporting and detection limits.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Select an applicable detection/reporting-limit data-quality record, verify censor code, and convert the limit unit.
platform_mappings.controlled_vocabulary: ODM2 DataQualityType and CensorCode controlled vocabularies
platform_mappings.information_loss: The canonical field does not distinguish method detection limit from reporting level unless retained in method provenance.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Validated WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Parse decimal degrees and validate range; preserve source coordinate text separately.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Source precision and datum require additional fields.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Transform to EPSG:4326 only when source datum is known; do not relabel NAD27 coordinates as WGS84.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Variable source resolution is not represented in latitude alone.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve the spatial reference and transform to EPSG:4326 when required.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Site geometry beyond the point coordinate is not retained.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the point latitude when the geolocation describes the sampled feature and validate range.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Place, box and polygon context are not represented in one latitude.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Validated WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Parse decimal degrees, use negative for west and validate range; preserve source text separately.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Source precision and datum require additional fields.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Transform to EPSG:4326 only when source datum is known and preserve longitudes west of the International Date Line correctly.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Variable source resolution is not represented in longitude alone.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve the spatial reference and transform to EPSG:4326 when required.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Site geometry beyond the point coordinate is not retained.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the point longitude when the geolocation describes the sampled feature and validate range.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Place, box and polygon context are not represented in one longitude.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Declared coordinate reference system or source datum before canonical transformation.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use an explicitly declared CRS; the template recommendation for decimal degrees is not by itself proof of EPSG:4326.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The reviewed overview does not expose a dedicated CRS field.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Construct a resolvable CRS description from datum and spheroid; do not guess when absent.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Projection and coordinate-operation details may still be unavailable.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Prefer a resolvable SRSCode and retain SRSName in source metadata.
platform_mappings.information_loss: SRS description and external identifiers are not retained in one string.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Treat DataCite geolocation coordinates according to its schema guidance; do not invent a source CRS field.
platform_mappings.information_loss: A separate source record is needed to preserve non-DataCite coordinate provenance.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Date or date-time when the sample was collected.

external_path: Sample Metadata collection date when supplied as an extra field
platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy an explicit collection date and normalize only unambiguous ISO-compatible dates.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The template permits extra fields but the reviewed overview does not require collection date.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Parse the documented month/day/year source date and emit ISO 8601 when unambiguous.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Time of day and timezone are unavailable.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use BeginDateTime of the specimen-collection action linked to the sampling feature.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Action timezone offset and end time need source provenance if relevant.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Select only a date whose dateType is Collected.
platform_mappings.information_loss: DateInformation and multiple collection intervals are flattened.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Minimum sampling depth below the declared surface, in metres.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Parse a lower bound only when value, unit and reference surface are explicit; convert to metres.
platform_mappings.information_loss: AGDB2 DEPTH may be a single value with submitter-specified units and may not define an interval.

external_path: sampling-feature extension properties or specimen hierarchy
platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use a documented depth extension/property and its units; core site elevation is not sample depth.
platform_mappings.information_loss: No portable core field was identified in the reviewed schema surface.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Accept only an explicit submitted depth field and unit; do not infer from elevation.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The reviewed template overview does not establish a portable depth field.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Maximum sampling depth below the declared surface, in metres.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Populate an upper bound only when the source explicitly encodes an interval; convert its unit to metres.
platform_mappings.information_loss: A single AGDB2 depth value must not be duplicated into both interval bounds without a declared convention.

external_path: sampling-feature extension properties or specimen hierarchy
platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use a documented interval-depth extension and units.
platform_mappings.information_loss: No portable core field was identified in the reviewed schema surface.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Accept only an explicit submitted interval-depth field and unit.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The reviewed template overview does not establish a portable interval-depth field.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Reported or mapped lithologic description for the sampled material.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the submitted lithology and retain the vocabulary/ontology reference when available in provenance.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Vocabulary identifier and hierarchy are not represented in the text field alone.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Populate only when a source field explicitly describes rock or sediment lithology; PRIMARY_CLASS alone is too broad.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Free-text or sample-name interpretation may be less precise than a geologic ontology.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Select a documented lithology extension property linked to the sampling feature.
platform_mappings.controlled_vocabulary: Extension-property vocabulary selected by the deployment
platform_mappings.information_loss: ODM2 core does not mandate one lithology property.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use an explicit lithologic material term and retain subjectScheme when available.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Free-text discovery metadata may not distinguish observed lithology from a project keyword.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Source-reported analytical method, technique or method code.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve the Data-tab method code to its analytical metadata and serialize code, technique and instrument without dropping the linkage.
platform_mappings.information_loss: One text field flattens method code, technique and instrument.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve the short method name through the AnalyticMethod table and retain its definition/source.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Short code alone is insufficient without the lookup metadata.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Follow the result to its feature action and action, then resolve the linked method code/name.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Method description, organization, link and action sequence are flattened.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Do not derive analytical method from sample PID metadata.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Methods belong to an observation or related resource, not the sample identifier itself.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Normalized high-level analytical method family used for comparability grouping.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Map only recognized technique/instrument combinations to the D2 method-family vocabulary.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Detailed method conditions are intentionally coarsened.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Classify from the resolved method definition, not from an element-specific result column name.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Different procedures can share a method family and remain analytically non-equivalent.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Map the controlled method type and name to the D2 family vocabulary.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The canonical family is coarser than the ODM2 method record.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Sample digestion, leach, extraction or preparation relevant to analytical comparability.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Extract only an explicit preparation/digestion statement and preserve the source method text.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The reviewed template overview does not guarantee a dedicated digestion field.

external_path: AnalyticMethod method definition and cited source
platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Classify digestion/extraction from the resolved method documentation; do not infer from instrument family alone.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Method documentation may omit exact reagent volumes or conditions.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Follow specimen-preparation actions and linked methods that precede the lab-analysis action.
platform_mappings.controlled_vocabulary: ODM2 ActionType, RelationshipType and MethodType controlled vocabularies
platform_mappings.information_loss: The multi-step preparation graph is flattened to one label.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Laboratory or organization responsible for the reported analysis.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the laboratory name or code and retain its source definition when available.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Organization identifiers and address are not represented in a single name.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Do not reinterpret LAB_ID as a laboratory organization; use method/source metadata only when it explicitly names the lab.
platform_mappings.information_loss: LAB_ID identifies the submitted sample, not necessarily the performing laboratory.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve the method organization and copy its name when it is the performing laboratory.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Organization identifiers and role semantics are not retained in the text field.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Reference material used for calibration or method quality assessment.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the explicitly reported reference-sample/material identifier.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Certificate, lot and accepted values require separate evidence.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Leave null unless linked analytical-method documentation explicitly identifies a reference material.
platform_mappings.information_loss: No record-level reference-material field was identified in the reviewed AGDB2 surface.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve the reference material linked to the applicable calibration or quality action and preserve code plus lot when available.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Accepted values, certificate and organization are flattened unless retained in provenance.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Source-reported detection or reporting limit before unit normalization.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy only an explicitly reported limit and retain the applicable parameter/method linkage.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Limit type is ambiguous unless stated in method metadata.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use DATA_VALUE as a limit only when QUALIFIER and dataset metadata establish it as such.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Method detection limit and reporting limit may not be distinguishable.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Select a DataQuality record whose type is the applicable detection/reporting limit.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The canonical field does not retain data-quality type or supporting link.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Unit in which detection_limit was reported.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the explicitly associated limit unit.
platform_mappings.information_loss: None when the unit is explicitly tied to the same limit.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use the result unit only when the encoded limit is documented in the same unit.
platform_mappings.information_loss: A method-level limit in a different unit cannot be represented without additional metadata.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve the units linked to the selected DataQuality limit record.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Units name/type/URI are not retained in the abbreviation alone.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Stable identifier for the source dataset or collection within the workflow.

external_path: Data Source persistent identifier or repository identifier
platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Prefer a persistent dataset identifier; otherwise use the repository accession and namespace it.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Identifier type and resolver require source metadata.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use the USGS publication/catalog identifier for the dataset, not a sample LAB_ID.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Version and file identity remain separate.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Prefer DatasetUUID; otherwise namespace DatasetCode by repository.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Dataset type and title remain separate.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Select a related dataset identifier only when relationType expresses the sample-to-dataset relationship.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Multiple related datasets are reduced to one source_id per canonical record.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Human-readable title of the source dataset or collection.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the repository data-source title.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Alternate and translated titles are not represented.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the title from authoritative USGS dataset metadata.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Series and publication-number metadata remain separate.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy DatasetTitle for the dataset linked to the Result.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Dataset abstract is not retained in this field.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve an explicitly related dataset identifier and copy its registered title; do not use the sample title as the dataset title.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Requires dereferencing a related dataset record.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: DOI identifying the source dataset or associated data publication, not the sample IGSN unless they are explicitly the same resource.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Normalize an explicit DOI to a stable DOI string or URL without changing identity.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Relation type to the sample/result may need the full repository record.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy only a DOI explicitly assigned to the dataset or publication; otherwise leave null and use source_locator.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Many USGS legacy releases use publication URLs rather than DOIs.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve a DOI external identifier for a citation related to the dataset.
platform_mappings.controlled_vocabulary: ODM2 RelationshipType and external identifier system
platform_mappings.information_loss: Citation relationship and bibliographic metadata are not retained in the DOI alone.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Select a DOI-typed related identifier that denotes an associated dataset; do not copy the sample identifier by default.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Multiple related resources require one record per selected source dataset.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Version label of the exact source dataset release.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy an explicit repository version; do not substitute access date.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Repository revision history may contain more detail than one label.

external_path: dataset edition/version in title and metadata
platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the stated release version, such as 2.0, and retain publication identity separately.
platform_mappings.information_loss: File-level revisions may differ from dataset edition.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Select VersionCode from an explicit version relationship for the dataset.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Version lineage graph is reduced to one label.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Resolve the related dataset DOI and copy its registered DataCite version; do not use the sample record version.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Requires dereferencing the related resource.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Resolvable citation, URL, accession or row locator supporting trace-back to the source record.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Prefer a stable DOI or accession URL and append a record/sample fragment only when the platform defines it.
platform_mappings.information_loss: A single locator may not identify both dataset and exact source row.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use the stable publication URL plus an explicit table/key locator in a documented syntax.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Legacy releases may not expose persistent row URLs.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use CitationLink and the relevant DatasetID/ResultID namespace to construct a reproducible locator.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Internal numeric IDs are not globally resolvable without the hosting endpoint.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Use the registered DOI URL for the sample or explicitly related dataset, according to the record being traced.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The locator alone does not encode which relation justified its selection.

field_mappings.canonical_definition: Declared license or rights statement governing reuse of the source data.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Copy the dataset-specific declared license; do not infer a license from repository access alone.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Repository policy and dataset license may both be needed for legal interpretation.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Preserve the authoritative constraints text and map to an SPDX-style identifier only when equivalence is explicit.
platform_mappings.information_loss: A short identifier can omit attribution and disclaimer language.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Store dataset license in repository/provenance metadata; do not invent an ODM2 core license field.
platform_mappings.information_loss: The reviewed ODM2 core schema surface does not establish a dataset-rights field.

platform_mappings.conversion_rule: Prefer rightsIdentifier or rightsUri and retain the rights text in source provenance.
platform_mappings.information_loss: Multiple rights statements are reduced to one canonical field.

non_core_fields.rationale: Workflow audit, deterministic identity, transformation evidence and operational QC fields. They are deliberately retained as D2 extensions and must not be presented as native EarthChem, AGDB2, ODM2 or IGSN/DataCite fields.

Important duplicate-resolution, sample-type, water/sediment context, method-scope, citation and spatial-geology enrichment fields, but the reviewed sources do not establish sufficiently portable one-to-one mappings. Future versions should add GeoSciML/CGI, method and rights vocabularies plus platform-specific extensions before claiming alignment.
